Reason (dev's read on `f068cde8`): that loader already reads `client.list('object')` but keeps only each name, so `RefObjectWidget` never receives a label. Carrying the label from the same response keeps the order's "no second object-list fetch"; the widget calling the object catalog hook instead would be a second list read. Shape: a `WidgetContext` member mapping name → label built from the same loaded list; `objectNames` and `ObjectSelectorWidget` unchanged. Outside every other seat's live files. Nothing else in the claim changes.
